course.title: Unit 2 My favourite season-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（Why do you like this season?）

sentences.content: Hello, Miss White. Look at my picture.
sentences.english: Hello , Miss White . Look at my picture

sentences.content: Good job! I like the trees.
sentences.english: Good job ! I like the trees

sentences.content: The weather is good and the colours are beautiful!
sentences.english: The weather is good and the colours are beautiful !

sentences.content: Which season do you like best, Miss White?
sentences.english: Which season do you like best , Miss White ?
sentences.chinese: White小姐，你最喜欢哪个季节？

sentences.content: Which season do you like best?
sentences.english: Which season do you like best ?

sentences.chinese: 因为那里有美丽的花朵。

sentences.content: I often go on a picnic with my family.
sentences.english: I often go on a picnic with my family
sentences.chinese: 我经常和家人一起去野餐。

sentences.content: Which season do you like best?
sentences.english: Which season do you like best ?

sentences.content: Winter. I often play in the snow.
sentences.english: Winter . I often play in the snow
sentences.chinese: 冬天。我常在雪地里玩耍。

sentences.content: I like spring because there are beautiful flowers everywhere.
sentences.english: I like spring because there are beautiful flowers everywhere
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢春天，因为到处都有美丽的花朵。

sentences.content: I like summer, but I can’t swim.
sentences.english: I like summer , but I can't swim
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢夏天，但我不会游泳。

sentences.content: The leaves fall and fall and fall. I love fall!
sentences.english: The leaves fall and fall and fall . I love fall !
sentences.chinese: 叶子不停地飘落。我爱秋天！

sentences.content: I like winter because I can play in the snow.
sentences.english: I like winter because I can play in the snow
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢冬天，因为可以在雪地里玩耍。

sentences.content: Why do you like spring best?
sentences.english: Why do you like spring best ?

sentences.content: Which season do you like best?
sentences.english: Which season do you like best ?

sentences.content: When do you go to school?
sentences.english: When do you go to school ?

sentences.content: I go to school at 8 o’clock.
sentences.english: I go to school at 8 o'clock

sentences.content: What do you often do on the weekend?
sentences.english: What do you often do on the weekend ?
